name: Carinthia
summary: Three horizontal bands of yellow, red and white. The colours come from the Carinthian arms: three black lions on gold beside a red-white-red shield.
origin: The arms date from the 13th century, combining the Babenberg-era lions with Austria's red-white-red. The tricolour has been used since the 19th century.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The gold of the lion half of the arms.

facts: A Slovene-speaking minority lives in southern Carinthia.
clues: Yellow, red and white horizontal bands.
Its colours come from three black lions on gold and an Austrian shield.
